shortDescription: DefiLlama data shows that Pons generated more than $630,000 in revenue over the past 24 hours, bringing cumulative revenue to $8.24 million. According to Odaily, Pons also recorded $2.06 million in revenue over the past seven days and $4.32 million over the past 30 days.
